title: A voice yelling 'freeze' saves him before the Two Bits bunker blast

tellings.quote: was going down the steps into the bunker and I heard somebody yell freeze so I stopped and I looked around and the whole bunker disappeared just vaporized

plain: During the Vietnam War, at a military outpost called Fire Base Two Bits, Joe McMoneagle was walking down the steps into a bunker when he heard someone yell "freeze." He stopped and looked around, and "the whole bunker disappeared, just vaporized." McMoneagle, who served in Vietnam, tells Michels this happened to him, and he tells it as a warning from a voice no one can account for, one that saved his life.
